# The Children's Collective of Florida, Inc.

> A Florida 501(c)(3) turning community generosity into clothing, essentials and dignity for local children in foster care, kinship homes and crisis.

Serving Martin County, extending our reach to neighboring communities.

- Also known as: CCOF. Registered DBA: The Collective Kids Closet.
- Tagline: Powered by Community. Supporting Kids.
- EIN: 42-2020310
- Florida Document No.: N26000005374
- Florida Charitable Registration (FDACS): CH83131
- IRS determination letter: May 12, 2026 (effective April 13, 2026)
- Candid profile: https://app.candid.org/profile/16616338/the-childrens-collective-of-florida-42-2020310/?pkId=9fd7c9a1-d88f-4e41-a8f4-dff9801a3d51
- Contact: info@ChildrensCollectiveFL.org, (772) 202-0554, 770 SE Indian St, Stuart, FL 34997, US
- Donated goods move by scheduled pickup. No walk-in hours.

## Key pages

- [Give Goods](https://childrenscollectivefl.org/give-goods): What we accept, in what condition, and every way to give quality kids' goods.
- [Pickup](https://childrenscollectivefl.org/pickup): Kids' goods to donate anywhere in Martin County? Let us come to you. Outside Martin County? Write to us and we'll make arrangements whenever we can.
- [Donate](https://childrenscollectivefl.org/donate): Tax-deductible one-time or monthly gifts that fund practical support for kids in foster care, kinship homes, and crisis.
- [Where It Goes](https://childrenscollectivefl.org/where-it-goes): Our transparency commitment and a public account of what we collect and where proceeds go.
- [Registration](https://childrenscollectivefl.org/registration): Official Florida charitable registration (#CH83131) and financial information, as required by Florida law.
- [Sources](https://childrenscollectivefl.org/sources): Full citations for the child-welfare statistics cited across the site.
- [Partner With Us](https://childrenscollectivefl.org/partner): Donate, host a bin or drive, become a partner nonprofit, or request support.
- [Partner Nonprofits](https://childrenscollectivefl.org/partner-nonprofits): How 501(c)(3) organizations serving children in foster care, kinship care, or crisis request goods, contributed directly to the partner.
- [How It Works](https://childrenscollectivefl.org/how-it-works): You give, we steward, and donated goods reach the 501(c)(3) partner organizations caring for local children.
- [About](https://childrenscollectivefl.org/about): Mission, story, founder, and board.
